summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified. rmcp Streamable HTTP service mounted at /mcp with ServerHandler, bearer-token auth with standards-compliant 401 challenge, resource_metadata derived from MCP_PUBLIC_RESOURCE_URL, all nine tools ported to typed SDK handlers, domain behavior preserved, identity in task-local with concurrency isolation test, calendar_list permission mapping corrected, custom dispatcher retired. 249 tests pass, clippy clean.
important_context: The custom dispatcher (Gateway::handle_authorized_tool_call) is retired from the main request path but retained for integration tests that exercise audit recording
calendar_list now maps to grant.allow_availability via its own check_tool_permission entry rather than reusing the availability_find capability
Identity is stored in a tokio task-local (identity::IDENTITY) set by auth middleware and read by tool handlers at call time
